<script>
    function cleanBackgroundImageSrc() {
        // Get all elements on the page
        const elements = document.querySelectorAll('*');

        // Loop through each element
        elements.forEach((element) => {
            const style = element.getAttribute('style');

            // Check if the element has an inline style and contains a background-image
            if (style && style.includes('background-image')) {
                const backgroundImageMatch = style.match(/background-image:\s*url\(["']?(.*?)["']?\)/);

                // If a background-image URL is found
                if (backgroundImageMatch && backgroundImageMatch[1].includes('cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,width=1496/')) {
                    const originalUrl = backgroundImageMatch[1];
                    const cleanedUrl = originalUrl.replace('cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,width=1496/', '');

                    // Update the inline style with the cleaned URL
                    const cleanedStyle = style.replace(originalUrl, cleanedUrl);
                    element.setAttribute('style', cleanedStyle);
                }
            }
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', cleanBackgroundImageSrc);
</script>



<script>

    function cleanImageSrc() {
  // Get all img elements on the page
  const images = document.querySelectorAll('img');

  // Loop through each img element
  images.forEach((img) => {
    const src = img.getAttribute('src');

    // Check if the src contains the unwanted path and remove it
    if (src.includes('cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,width=1496/')) {
      const cleanedSrc = src.replace('cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,width=1496/', '');
      img.setAttribute('src', cleanedSrc);
    }
  });
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', cleanImageSrc);


</script>


<script>
    function cleanBackgroundImageSrc() {
        // Get all elements on the page
        const elements = document.querySelectorAll('*');
 
        // Loop through each element
        elements.forEach((element) => {
            const style = element.getAttribute('style');
 
            // Check if the element has an inline style and contains a background-image
            if (style && style.includes('background-image')) {
                const backgroundImageMatch = style.match(/background-image:\s*url\(["']?(.*?)["']?\)/);
 
                // If a background-image URL is found
                if (backgroundImageMatch && backgroundImageMatch[1].includes('cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,width=748/')) {
                    const originalUrl = backgroundImageMatch[1];
                    const cleanedUrl = originalUrl.replace('cdn-cgi/image/f=auto,width=748/', '');
 
                    // Update the inline style with the cleaned URL
                    const cleanedStyle = style.replace(originalUrl, cleanedUrl);
                    element.setAttribute('style', cleanedStyle);
                }
            }
        });
    }
 
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', cleanBackgroundImageSrc);
</script>
